scope: The standing Atiq mosque enclosure with its four ranges around the open courtyard, portal towers, connected north range and the Khuda Khane pavilion inside the courtyard.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The present mosque is mainly a Safavid four-iwan court. Its pavilion has a stone core measuring about 5.5 by 7 metres, perimeter loggias with three arches on each side, four rounded corner towers and a blue frieze.
The Athar study documents the freestanding, single-storey stone pavilion and analyzes construction and restoration sequences.
The architectural survey distinguishes the larger north, east and south iwans and smaller connections on the west range.

next: Model the roofed perimeter around the open court, north iwan and paired turrets, and the four-cornered pavilion and its loggias.
